title: JANUS Classical Shor Arena — Collision-Guided Multiplicative Order Finding

method.EXACT_JANUS: exact reduction and minimal multiplicative-order certificate

scientific_boundary.supported: Finite disjoint holdout evidence that this classical collision-guided JANUS order finder can recover exact r with fewer residue probes and, on this benchmark, lower median modular-multiplication work than a linear order scan.
not_supported: equivalence to Shor quantum period finding
scientific_boundary.scaling_warning: Birthday-style O(sqrt(r)) residue probes can still be exponential in input bit-length because r can be O(N).

next_gate.name: JANUS_CLASSICAL_SHOR_ARENA_SCALE_LADDER_V2
next_gate.goal: Freeze larger bit-length semiprime families and compare against stronger classical order-finding baselines, not only linear scan.
required_baselines: baby-step/giant-step style order finding or equivalent best classical collision baseline
next_gate.rule: Do not promote finite holdout performance to an asymptotic claim.
